C1064.title: Destruction of Military Installations Leads to Arrest of Two Individuals
C1064.summary: On February 1, 2021, defendants Ma and Yang, each carrying a cutting machine, drove a tricycle into the shooting range military-controlled zone of Troop A, cut a metal tank moving combat target into pieces to haul away as scrap iron, and were caught by patrol police on the way back. The damaged military installation was valued at 29,335 yuan. On August 6 that year, the court sentenced Ma to 2 years 8 months and Yang to 2 years 6 months for the crime of destroying military installations. This is a typical case (Case 4) published by the SPP on endangering national defense interests.
